While inside the Zone, enemy targets receive 15.0% increased Ultimate DMG, with a 60% base chance of being inflicted with 1 stack of Ashen Roast when taking action. While the Zone exists, this effect can trigger up to 6 time(s). And for each enemy target, it can only trigger once per turn. This trigger count resets every time Jiaoqiu uses Ultimate.
The Zone lasts for 3 turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. If Jiaoqiu gets knocked down, the Zone will also be dispelled.

When Jiaoqiu hits an enemy with Basic ATK, Skill or Ultimate, there is a 100% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Ashen Roast on them. At 1 stack, increases DMG received by the enemy by 15.0%. Then, each subsequent stack increases this by 5.0%.
Ashen Roast is capped at 5 stack(s) and lasts for 2 turn(s).
When an enemy target is afflicted with Ashen Roast, they are also considered as being Burned at the same time, taking Fire DoT equal to 180% of Jiaoqiu's ATK at the start of each turn.

Applies Physical Weakness to one designated enemy target, lasting for 2 turn(s).
Deals Physical DMG equal to 400% of Boothill's ATK to the target and delays their action by 40%.

skills.label: Talent: Five Peas in a Pod (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Each stack of Pocket Trickshot increases the Enhanced Basic Attack's Toughness Reduction by 50%, stacking up to 3 time(s).
If the target is Weakness Broken while the Enhanced Basic ATK is being used, based on the number of Pocket Trickshot stacks, deals Break DMG to this target equal to 70%/120%/170% of Boothill's Physical Break DMG. The max Toughness taken into account for this DMG cannot exceed 16 times the base Toughness Reduction of the Basic Attack "Skullcrush Spurs."
After winning the battle, Boothill can retain Pocket Trickshot for the next battle.

skills.label: Technique: 3-9× Smile
skills.gameText: After the Technique is used, when casting the Skill for the first time in the next battle, applies the same Physical Weakness to the target as the one induced by the Ultimate, lasting for 2 turn(s).

skills.label: Basic ATK: Fanning the Hammer (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText:
Deals Physical DMG equal to 220% of Boothill's ATK to one designated enemy target.
The Enhanced Basic Attack cannot recover Skill Points and can only target the enemy that is in the "Standoff" state.

skills.label: Trace: Ghost Load
skills.gameText: Increase this character's CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG, by an amount equal to 10%/50% of Break Effect, up to a max increase of 30%/150%.

skills.label: Trace: Above Snakes
skills.gameText: While Boothill is in the Standoff, reduces the DMG he receives from targets that are not in the Standoff by 30%.

skills.label: Trace: Point Blank
skills.gameText: When in Standoff and gaining Pocket Trickshot, regenerates 10 Energy. Can also trigger this effect when gaining Pocket Trickshot stacks that exceed the max limit.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Dusty Trail's Lone Star
skills.gameText: When the battle starts, obtains 1 stack of Pocket Trickshot. When Boothill deals DMG, ignores 16% of the enemy target's DEF.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Milestonemonger
skills.gameText: When in Standoff and gaining Pocket Trickshot, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) and increases Break Effect by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s). Can also trigger this effect when gaining Pocket Trickshot stacks that exceed the max limit. But cannot trigger repeatedly within one turn.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Marble Orchard's Guard
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Cold Cuts Chef
skills.gameText: When the enemy target in the Standoff is attacked by Boothill, the DMG they receive additionally increases by 12%. When Boothill is attacked by the enemy target in the Standoff, the effect of him receiving increased DMG is offset by 12%.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Stump Speech
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Crowbar Hotel's Raccoon
skills.gameText: When triggering the Talent's Break DMG, additionally deals Break DMG to the target equal to 40% of the original DMG multiplier and additionally deals Break DMG to adjacent targets equal to 70% of the original DMG multiplier.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Ninjutsu: Rise Above Tumbles (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 100% of Rappa's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Ninja Strike: Rooted Resolute (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 120% of Rappa's ATK to all enemies.

skills.label: Ultimate: Nindō Supreme: Aishiteru (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Enters the "Sealform" state, immediately gains 1 extra turn, obtains 3 points of "Chroma Ink," and increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 50% and Break Effect by 30%.
While in the "Sealform" state, Basic ATK is enhanced, and Skill and Ultimate cannot be used. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes 1 point of "Chroma Ink." When "Chroma Ink" is depleted, exits the "Sealform" state.

skills.label: Talent: Ninja Tech: Endurance Gauge (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Each time the enemy target is Weakness Broken, Rappa gains 1 point of Charge, up to a max of 10 points of Charge. When Rappa next launches the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," additionally deals Break DMG equal to 60% of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to all enemies. This DMG can ignore Weakness Type to reduce 2 Toughness, consuming all Charge. Each point of Charge increases the Break DMG multiplier by 50% and increases the Toughness Reduction that can ignore Weakness Type by 1.
When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

skills.label: Technique: Ninja Dash: By Leaps and Bounds
skills.gameText: After using Technique, enters the "Graffiti" state for 20 seconds. While in the "Graffiti" state, moves forward rapidly for a set distance and attacks any enemies touched. During the rapid movement, can block all enemies' attacks. Using an attack in the "Graffiti" state can end the state's duration early. After entering combat via attacking enemies, deals 30 Toughness Reduction regardless of Weakness Type and Break DMG equal to 200% of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to each enemy target, and deals Break DMG equal to 180% of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to adjacent targets. At the same time, this unit regenerates 10 Energy.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText:
Launches "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade." The first 2 hits deal Imaginary DMG equal to 100% of Rappa's ATK to one designated enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to 50% of Rappa's ATK to adjacent targets, and the 3rd hit deals Imaginary DMG equal to 100% of Rappa's ATK to all enemies.
Enhanced Basic ATK will not recover Skill Points. Attacking enemies that don't have Imaginary Weakness can also reduce Toughness, whose effect is equal to 50% of the original Toughness Reduction. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

skills.label: Trace: Ninjutsu Inscription: Sky High
skills.gameText: When the Weakness of an elite-level or higher enemy is broken, Rappa additionally gains 1 point(s) of Charge and regenerates 10 Energy.

skills.label: Trace: Ninjutsu Inscription: Sea Echo
skills.gameText: While in the "Sealform" state, after Rappa uses Enhanced Basic ATK to deal DMG to a Weakness Broken enemy target, converts the Toughness Reduction from this instance of DMG to 1 instance of 60% Super Break DMG.

skills.label: Trace: Ninjutsu Inscription: Withered Leaf
skills.gameText: When an enemy target becomes Weakness Broken, increases the Break DMG taken by 2%. If Rappa's current ATK is higher than 2400, for every 100 excess ATK, additionally increases this value by 1%, up to a max additional increase of 8%. This effect lasts for 2 turn(s).

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Returned Is the Revenant With No Ferry Toll
skills.gameText: During the "Sealform" state entered by using Ultimate, DMG dealt by Rappa ignores 15% of the targets' DEF. After exiting the "Sealform" state, regenerates 20 Energy.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Free Is the Mind Enlightened by Haikus
skills.gameText: The Enhanced Basic ATK's first 2 hits have their Toughness Reduction against the one designated enemy increased by 50%.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Many Are the Shrines That Repel No Hell
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Lost Is the Nindō Devoured by Time
skills.gameText: While in the "Sealform" state, increases all allies' SPD by 12%.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Steady Is The Ranger With Unerring Arrows
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Righteous Is the Wrath That Spares No Evil
skills.gameText: When battle starts, Rappa gains 5 point(s) of her Talent's Charge, and its upper limit increases by 5 point(s). After launching the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," gains 5 point(s) of Charge.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Fiddle... Fissured Memory (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Fire DMG equal to 100% of The Dahlia's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Lick... Enkindled Betrayal (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Deploys a Zone that lasts for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of The Dahlia's turn. Then, deals Fire DMG equal to 160% of The Dahlia's ATK to one designated enemy and their adjacent targets.
While the Zone lasts, increases all allies' Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%. Toughness Reduction taken by enemy targets while not Weakness Broken can also be converted into Super Break DMG.

skills.label: Ultimate: Wallow... Entombed Ash (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Inflicts a "Wilt" state on all enemies, lasting for 4 turn(s). Then, deals Fire DMG equal to 300% of The Dahlia's ATK, which is distributed evenly across all enemies.
Enemy targets in the "Wilt" state have their DEF reduced by 18.0% and will be implanted with Weakness of all Dance Partners' Types.

skills.label: Talent: Who's Afraid of Constance? (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
When entering combat, The Dahlia regenerates 35 Energy and becomes "Dance Partners" along with the teammate that triggered combat. Whenever there is no other "Dance Partner" on the field, this unit and the teammate with the highest Break Effect become "Dance Partners" together. After a "Dance Partner" attacks a Weakness Broken enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this attack will be converted into 1 instance of Super Break DMG at 60%.
After an enemy target gets attacked by the other "Dance Partner," The Dahlia launches Follow-Up ATK and deals 5 instance(s) of DMG, each dealing Fire DMG equal to 30% of The Dahlia's ATK to one random enemy. After each instance of DMG dealt to a Weakness Broken enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this DMG will be converted into 1 instance of Super Break DMG at 200%.
This effect can only trigger once per turn. If the target is defeated before the Follow-Up ATK is used, it will be launched at one random enemy instead.

skills.label: Technique: The Heart Makes the Finest Tomb
skills.gameText:
After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 20 second(s). Enemies within this dimension will not actively attack ally targets. After entering combat with enemies in the Special Dimension, The Dahlia immediately deploys her Skill's Zone, and converts the combat-triggering Toughness Reduction into 1 instance of Super Break DMG at 60% against enemy targets that are Weakness Broken.
Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skills.label: Trace: Yet Another Funeral
skills.gameText: When entering combat, increases other characters' Break Effect by an amount equal to 24% of The Dahlia's Break Effect plus 50%, lasting for 1 turn(s). When The Dahlia receives healing or a Shield provided by a teammate, this effect triggers again, lasting for 3 turn(s). Cannot trigger repeatedly within one turn.

skills.label: Trace: Lament, Lost Soul
skills.gameText: When using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, recovers 1 Skill Point for allies. For every 2 instance(s) of Talent's Follow-Up ATK used, this effect can trigger once.

skills.label: Trace: Outgrow the Old, Espouse the New
skills.gameText: When an ally target adds Weakness to an enemy target, increases SPD by 30% for 2 turn(s). If a Fire ally character has implanted a Weakness when using an attack, then after the attack, additionally deals a fixed amount of 20 Fire Toughness Reduction to every target implanted with Weakness. Also, regenerates Energy equal to 10% of Max Energy. This effect can regenerate Energy up to 50% of Max Energy.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: When a Bud Readies to Bloom
skills.gameText: The Super Break DMG multiplier provided by Talent to "Dance Partners" now applies to all ally characters, with "Dance Partners" additionally receiving a 40% boost. After "Dance Partners" use an attack, additionally deals the attacked enemy targets a fixed amount of Toughness Reduction equal to 25% of their Max Toughness (minimum 10, maximum 300). This effect can only trigger once per enemy target, and this trigger count resets after the enemy target receives a killing blow.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Fresh, Ethereal, and Beloved
skills.gameText: When The Dahlia is on the field, decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by 20%. When an enemy target enters the field, immediately inflicts "Wilt" on them, lasting for 3 turn(s).

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Pity Its Petals Thin as Mist
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Pity Its Heart Gnawed by Worms
skills.gameText: Increases the number of DMG instances dealt by Talent's Follow-Up ATK by 5. Upon its use, the DMG taken by all enemy targets increases by 12%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Fallen, Decayed, and Despised
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: And Yet, Always, Deathly Beautiful
skills.gameText: Increases Dance Partners' Break Effect by 150%. When using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, advances the next action of all "Dance Partners" by 20%.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Did You Get It (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Ice DMG equal to 100% of The Herta's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Big Brain Energy (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Ice DMG equal to 70% of The Herta's ATK to one designated enemy, and inflicts 1 stack(s) of "Interpretation." Deals Ice DMG equal to 70% of The Herta's ATK to the targets hit by this instance of Skill and their respective adjacent targets. This effect can repeat 2 times.

skills.label: Ultimate: Told Ya! Magic Happens (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Rearranges the numbers of "Interpretation" stacks on all enemies, prioritizing the transfer of the higher numbers of "Interpretation" stacks to Elite-level targets and above. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to 200% of The Herta's ATK to all enemies. When using Ultimate, increases The Herta's ATK by 80%, lasting for 3 turn(s). After the use, The Herta immediately takes action and gains 1 stack of "Inspiration." "Inspiration" can stack up to 4 time(s). While having "Inspiration," enhances Skill to "Hear Me Out."

skills.label: Talent: Hand Them Over (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When enemy targets enter combat, The Herta inflicts 1 stack of "Interpretation" on them. At the start of each wave, applies 25 stack(s) of "Interpretation" to a random enemy target, prioritizing Elite-level targets and above. When the Enhanced Skill's primary target has "Interpretation," the multiplier for the DMG dealt increases, with each stack granting an increase of 8.0%/4.0% on the primary target/other targets respectively. If 2 or more characters follow the Path of Erudition in the team, each stack grants an additional increase of 8.0%/4.0% on the primary target/other targets respectively. "Interpretation" can stack up to 42 time(s). When using the Enhanced Skill, resets the number of "Interpretation" stacks on the primary target to 1. After the enemy target leaves the field or gets defeated by any unit, "Interpretation" will be transferred, prioritizing the transfer to Elite-level targets and above.

skills.label: Technique: Vibe Checker
skills.gameText:
After using Technique, increases The Herta's ATK by 60% at the start of the next battle, lasting for 2 turn(s).
If there are Basic Treasures in this current map, using Technique can mark up to 3 Basic Treasures' locations.
After entering battle by using Technique in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, at the start of each wave, deals True DMG to enemy targets lower than Elite-level by an amount equal to 99% of the targets' Max HP, and deals True DMG to enemy targets at Elite-level and above by an amount equal to 30% of the targets' Max HP.

skills.label: Skill: Hear Me Out (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Consumes 1 stack of "Inspiration." Deals Ice DMG equal to 80% of The Herta's ATK to one designated enemy and inflicts 1 stack(s) of "Interpretation." Deals Ice DMG equal to 80% of The Herta's ATK to the targets hit by this instance of Skill and their respective adjacent targets, repeating 2 times. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to 40% of The Herta's ATK to all enemies.

skills.label: Trace: Aloofly Honest
skills.gameText: When ally targets attack, inflicts 1 stack of "Interpretation" on the hit enemy target. After attacking, for every 1 target hit by this attack, regenerates 3 fixed Energy for The Herta, counting up to a maximum of 5 targets. When using Enhanced Skill, if the primary target's "Interpretation" stack reaches 42, increases the Ice DMG dealt by The Herta by 50%, lasting until the end of this attack.

skills.label: Trace: Message From Beyond the Veil
skills.gameText: When entering battle, if the team has 2 or more Erudition characters, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 80%. And the Trace "Aloofly Honest" counts at least 3 target(s) when calculating the number of targets hit. After attacking, applies 1 "Interpretation" stack(s) to the target that has the highest existing "Interpretation" stacks among the hit enemy targets. If the attacker is an Erudition character, then additionally applies 2 "Interpretation" stack(s).

skills.label: Trace: Starved Landscape of Vacua
skills.gameText: For every 1 stack of "Interpretation" inflicted on enemy targets, The Herta gains 1 stack of "Answer," up to a max of 99 stack(s). When using Ultimate, each "Answer" stack increases this instance of Ultimate's DMG multiplier by 1.0%.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Night at Shorefall
skills.gameText: When the Enhanced Skill calculates the number of "Interpretation" stacks, additionally counts 50% of the number of "Interpretation" stacks on the 1 target with the most stacks among the primary target and adjacent targets. When "Interpretation" is reset by using the Enhanced Skill, its stack number is reset to 15 instead.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Wind Through Keyhole
skills.gameText: After The Herta enters combat or uses Ultimate, additionally gains 1 "Inspiration" stack. After using Enhanced Skill, advances The Herta's next action by 35%.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Door into Summer
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: The Sixteenth Key
skills.gameText: The SPD of Erudition characters in the team increases by 12%.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Bitter Pill of Truth
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Sweet Lure of Answer
skills.gameText: The Herta's Ice RES PEN increases by 20%. When the number of enemy targets on the field is (≥3)/2/1, Ultimate's DMG multiplier increases by 140%/250%/400% respectively.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Thorned Nectar (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 100% of Aglaea's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Rise, Exalted Renown (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Restores HP to Garmentmaker by 50% of its Max HP. If Garmentmaker is absent, then summons the memosprite Garmentmaker and makes this unit immediately take action.

skills.label: Ultimate: Dance, Destined Weaveress (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Summons the memosprite Garmentmaker. If Garmentmaker is already on the field, then restores its HP to max. Aglaea enters the "Supreme Stance" state and immediately takes action.
While in "Supreme Stance," Aglaea gains the SPD Boost stacks from Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent, with each stack increasing this unit's SPD by 15.0%. Enhances Basic ATK to "Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss," and cannot use Skill. Garmentmaker is immune to Crowd Control debuffs.
A countdown appears in the Action Order, with its own SPD set at 100. While the countdown exists, using Ultimate again will reset the countdown. When the countdown's turn starts, Garmentmaker self-destructs. When Garmentmaker disappears, Aglaea dispels the "Supreme Stance" state.

skills.label: Talent: Rosy-Fingered (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: The memosprite Garmentmaker has an initial SPD equal to 35% of Aglaea's SPD and a Max HP equal to 66% of Aglaea's Max HP plus 720. While Garmentmaker is on the field, Aglaea's attacks inflict the target with the "Seam Stitch" state. After attacking enemies in the "Seam Stitch" state, further deals Lightning Additional DMG equal to 30% of Aglaea's ATK. "Seam Stitch" only takes effect on the most recently inflicted target.

skills.label: Technique: Meteoric Sunder
skills.gameText: Summons the memosprite Garmentmaker and launches a forward joint attack. After entering battle, regenerates 30 Energy and deals Lightning DMG equal to 100% of Aglaea's ATK to all enemy targets. Then, randomly inflicts the "Seam Stitch" state on a random enemy target.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText:
Aglaea and Garmentmaker launch a Joint ATK on the target, respectively dealing Lightning DMG equal to 200.0% of Aglaea's ATK and 200.0% of Garmentmaker's ATK to the target. Also, respectively deals Lightning DMG equal to 90% of Aglaea's ATK and 90% of Garmentmaker's ATK to adjacent targets.
"Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss" cannot recover Skill Points.

skills.label: Garmentmaker · Memosprite Skill: Thorned Snare (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 154% of ATK to one enemy and Lightning DMG equal to 92.4% of ATK to adjacent targets.

skills.label: Garmentmaker · Memosprite Talent: A Body Brewed by Tears (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: After attacking an enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch," increases this unit's SPD by 63.8, stacking up to 6 time(s). When Garmentmaker takes action, automatically uses "Thorned Snare," prioritizing enemies under the "Seam Stitch" state.

skills.label: Garmentmaker · Memosprite Talent: The Speeding Summer (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When Garmentmaker is summoned, this unit's action advances by 100%.

skills.label: Garmentmaker · Memosprite Talent: Bloom of Drying Grass (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When Garmentmaker disappears, regenerates 20 Energy for Aglaea.

skills.label: Trace: The Myopic's Doom
skills.gameText: While in "Supreme Stance," increases Aglaea's and Garmentmaker's ATK by an amount equal to 720% of Aglaea's SPD plus 360% of Garmentmaker's SPD.

skills.label: Trace: Last Thread of Fate
skills.gameText: When Garmentmaker disappears, up to 1 stack(s) of the SPD Boost from the Memosprite Talent can be retained. When Garmentmaker is summoned again, gains the corresponding number of SPD Boost stacks.

skills.label: Trace: The Speeding Sol
skills.gameText: At the start of battle, if this unit's Energy is lower than 50%, regenerates this unit's Energy to 50%.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Drift at the Whim of Venus
skills.gameText: The enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch" takes 15% increased DMG. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker attacks this target, additionally regenerates 20 Energy.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Sail on the Raft of Eyelids
skills.gameText: When Aglaea or Garmentmaker takes action, enables the DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker to ignore 14% of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to 3 time(s) and lasts until any unit, other than Aglaea or Garmentmaker, actively uses an ability.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Bequeath in the Coalescence of Dew
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Flicker Below the Surface of Marble
skills.gameText: The SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent has its max stack limit increased by 1. After Aglaea uses an attack, can also make Garmentmaker gain the SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Weave Under the Shroud of Woe
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Fluctuate in the Tapestry of Fates
skills.gameText: While Aglaea is in "Supreme Stance," increases her and Garmentmaker's Lightning RES PEN by 20%. When Aglaea's or Garmentmaker's SPD is greater than 160/240/320, the Joint ATK DMG dealt by them increases by 10%/30%/60%.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Hundred Rockets (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 30% of Tribbie's Max HP to one designated enemy. Deals Quantum DMG equal to 15% of Tribbie's Max HP to adjacent targets.

skills.label: Skill: Where'd the Gifts Go (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Gains "Numinosity," lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While Tribbie has "Numinosity," increases all ally targets' All-Type RES PEN by 24.0%.

skills.label: Ultimate: Guess Who Lives Here (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Activates a Zone and deals Quantum DMG equal to 30% of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies.
While the Zone lasts, increases enemy targets' DMG taken by 30.0%. After an ally target attacks, for every 1 target hit, deals 1 instance of Quantum Additional DMG equal to 12.0% of Tribbie's Max HP to the target that has the highest HP among the hit targets.
The Zone lasts for 2 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn.

skills.label: Talent: Busy as Tribbie (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: After other ally characters use Ultimate, Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Quantum DMG equal to 18.0% of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies. This effect triggers up to 1 time per character. When Tribbie uses Ultimate, resets the trigger count for other ally characters. If the target was defeated before the Follow-Up ATK is launched, then launches the Follow-Up ATK against new enemy targets entering the battlefield.

skills.label: Technique: If You're Happy and You Know It
skills.gameText: After using Technique and upon entering battle, obtains "Numinosity," lasting for 3 turn(s).

skills.label: Trace: Lamb Outside the Wall...
skills.gameText: After using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, increases the DMG dealt by Tribbie by 72%. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s), lasting for 3 turn(s).

skills.label: Trace: Glass Ball with Wings!
skills.gameText: While the Zone lasts, Tribbie's Max HP increases by an amount equal to 9% of the sum of all ally characters' Max HP.

skills.label: Trace: Pebble at Crossroads?
skills.gameText: At the start of battle, Tribbie regenerates 30 Energy. After other ally targets attack, Tribbie regenerates 1.5 Energy for each target hit.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Rite of Sugar Scoop
skills.gameText: While the Zone lasts and after ally targets attack enemies, additionally deals True DMG equal to 24% of the total DMG of this attack to targets that have been dealt Additional DMG by the Zone.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Guide of Dream Tour
skills.gameText: The Additional DMG dealt by the Zone increases to 120% of the original DMG. When the Zone deals Additional DMG, further deals 1 instance(s) of Additional DMG.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Trove of Morning Glow
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Peace of Empathy Bond
skills.gameText: While "Numinosity" lasts, the DMG dealt by all allies ignores 18% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Clock of Wonder Origin
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.gameText:
For each 1% of HP lost, accumulates 1 point of Charge (up to 200 points). When Charge reaches 100, consumes 100 points of Charge to enter the "Vendetta" state, restores HP equal to 25% of Mydei's Max HP, and advances action by 100%. While the "Vendetta" state is active, Max HP increases by 50% of the current Max HP and DEF remains at 0. At the start of this unit's turn, automatically uses "Kingslayer Be King."
When Charge reaches 150 points during the "Vendetta" state, Mydei immediately gains 1 extra turn and automatically uses "Godslayer Be God."
When receiving a killing blow during the "Vendetta" state, Mydei will not be knocked down, but will clear his Charge, exits the "Vendetta" state, and restores HP by 50% of his Max HP.

skills.label: Technique: Cage of Broken Lance

If actively attacking Dazed enemies, when entering battle, deals Imaginary DMG equal to 80% of Mydei's Max HP to all enemies, and Taunts the targets, lasting for 1 turn(s). This unit accumulates 50 point(s) of Talent's Charge.

skills.label: Skill: Kingslayer Be King (Lv. 10)

skills.label: Trace: Thirty Tyrants

Cipher will tally 12% of the non-True DMG dealt by ally targets to the "Patron." Overflow DMG will not be tallied. After using Ultimate, clears this tally.

At the same time, summons the memosprite Netherwing, advances its action by 100%, and deploys the Territory "Lost Netherland." Netherwing has its current HP equal to 50% of max "Newbud." skills.label: Skill: Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace (Lv. 10)

skills.gameText: Gains 3 "Recollection" point(s) and deploys a Zone that lasts for 2 turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of Cyrene's every turn. While the Zone lasts, for each instance of DMG dealt by all ally targets, deals 1 additional instance of True DMG equal to 24% of the original DMG. When Cyrene is downed, the Zone will also be dispelled.

skills.label: Ultimate: Verse ◦ Vow ∞ (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Summons memosprite Demiurge, causes it to immediately gain 1 extra turn, and activates all teammates' Ultimate. Then, enters the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state. Enhances Basic ATK to "To Love and Tomorrow ♪" and can only use this Basic ATK. Increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's CRIT Rate by 50%, and deploys the Zone effect from Skill with no duration limit.
Can only be used once per battle. Demiurge's initial Max HP equals to 100% of Cyrene's Max HP.

skills.label: Talent: Hearts Gather as One (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When combat begins or after Cyrene takes action, other ally characters under any state and their memosprites gain "Future." When ally targets with "Future" take action, consumes "Future" to grant Cyrene 1 "Recollection" point(s). When Cyrene has 24 "Recollection" points, can activate Ultimate and dispel all debuffs on her. When she has 12 "Recollection" points during the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state, can activate Ultimate. After reaching the maximum, it can overflow by up to 27 points. While Cyrene is on the field, increases DMG dealt by all ally targets by 20.0%.

skills.label: Technique: Peace at West Wind's End
skills.gameText: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 30 second(s) around the character. Enemies within this Special Dimension enter the "This Moment, Forever" state. While in this state, enemies will cease all actions. Ally characters within this Special Dimension have 50% increased movement speed. After entering combat within the duration, deploys the Skill's Zone. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skills.label: Basic ATK: To Love and Tomorrow ♪ (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText:
Gains 3 "Recollection" points and deals Ice DMG equal to 30% of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to 30% of Cyrene's Max HP to all enemies.
"To Love and Tomorrow ♪" cannot recover Skill Points.

skills.label: Ultimate: Reunion at First Sight (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Enables Demiurge to immediately gain 1 extra turn.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Minuet of Blooms and Plumes (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to 84% of Demiurge's Max HP.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: This Ode, to All Lives (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Applies a buff to one designated ally character. When the character is a Chrysos Heir, the target gains a special effect. When the character is not a Chrysos Heir, increases the target's DMG dealt by 56% for 2 turns. This effect also applies on memosprites.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Talent: Waiting, In Every Past (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Demiurge's SPD remains at 0, and it will not appear on the Action Order. While on the field, it is considered as Out-of-Bounds. When Cyrene's HP percentage changes, Demiurge's HP percentage will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's and Demiurge's Max HP increases by 33.6%. After Demiurge uses abilities, decreases the duration of all Continuous Effects on this unit by 1.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Talent: "Hello, World ♪" (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When Demiurge is summoned, dispels Crowd Control debuffs from all allies.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Genesis (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK by an amount equal to 22.4% of Demiurge's Max HP, and increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s CRIT Rate by an amount equal to 100.8% of Demiurge's CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK in this battle, Demiurge immediately gains 1 extra turn and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." If the target was defeated before this ability is used, it will be used on newly appeared enemy targets instead.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Romance (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: One-time effect. When used on Aglaea, causes Aglaea to gain "Romance" and immediately stacks Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, consumes "Romance" and regenerates 70 Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker by 100.8%, and ignores 50.4% of the targets' DEF, lasting until Aglaea exits the "Supreme Stance" state.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Passage (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore 16.8% of enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the Additional DMG from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals 1 instance(s) of Additional DMG.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Strife (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: One-time effect. When used on Mydei, removes all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted on him. And if Mydei is in the "Vendetta" state, he automatically uses 1 instance of "Godslayer Be God" without consuming Charge. Mydei's CRIT DMG increases by 280% during this attack. If the target gets defeated before the use, then it will target the newly arriving enemy targets instead. If Mydei is not in the "Vendetta" state, then advances Mydei's action by 100%.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Life and Death (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Castorice, "Newbud" can overflow up to 200%. When summoning Netherwing, consumes all overflowing "Newbud." For every 1% overflow amount consumed, increases the multiplier by 0.34% for the DMG dealt when this summoned Netherwing triggers the ability effect of its Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins." If there are 2 enemy target(s) or fewer on the field when summoned, the DMG multiplier additionally increases by 0.67%.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Reason (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: One-time effect. When used on Anaxa, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for allies and enables Anaxa to take action immediately. Skill has 3 more instances of DMG, lasting for 1 turn. The next time Anaxa uses Basic ATK or Skill, he gains "True Knowledge": All Erudition characters have their ATK increased by 84% and their dealt Skill DMG increased by 56%, lasting until the start of Anaxa's next turn.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Sky (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, causes Hyacine to gain 2 stacks of "Ode to Sky." When used on Hyacine, regenerates 33.6 Energy for Hyacine. When Hyacine has "Ode to Sky" and is providing healing, additionally increases the amount to be included in the tally of Little Ica's Memosprite Skill by an amount equal to 100.8% of the current healing amount. After Hyacine uses Skill/Ultimate, consumes 1 stack of "Ode to Sky."

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Trickery (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Cipher, increases the DMG dealt by Cipher by 50.4%, decreases the DEF of the "Patron" by 28% and decreases the DEF of all other enemy targets by 16.8%.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Worldbearing (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Phainon, Phainon gains 6 "Coreflame" as well as "Eternal Ignition" when Transforming. When Transforming, if "Coreflame" exceeds 12, for each point in excess, Khaslana's CRIT DMG increases by 16.8%, up to a max increase of 100.8%. While "Eternal Ignition" persists, increases Khaslana's CRIT Rate by 22.4%. After the extra turns are depleted, the Transformation does not end, and all of Khaslana's extra turns get refreshed and 4 "Scourge" is granted. At the start of extra turns, Khaslana consumes HP equal to 15% of his current HP. After using an attack, deals 5 instances of Additional DMG, with each instance dealing Fire Additional DMG equal to 14.0% of Khaslana's ATK to one random enemy.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Ocean (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: One-time effect. When used on Hysilens, Hysilens gains "Flowing Warmth." After Hysilens uses an attack, consumes "Flowing Warmth" and regenerates 60 Energy for this unit. In this battle, increases the DMG dealt by Hysilens by 168%. After Hysilens uses Basic ATK/Skill to attack enemies, causes all the DoT currently applied on the attacked enemy targets to immediately produce DMG equal to 84%/112% of the original DMG.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Law (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Effective for the entire battle. After using on Cerydra, increases the CRIT DMG of the character with "Military Merit" by 42%. After Coup de Main ends, Cerydra immediately gains 1 Charge.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Time (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Evernight, increases the DMG dealt when Evey uses the Memosprite Skill "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew" by 25.2%. After Evernight uses Skill/Ultimate, additionally gains 1 "Memoria." The CRIT DMG boost effect provided by the Skill is further increased by an amount equal to 16.8% of Evernight's CRIT DMG.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Earth (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, grants "Ode to Earth" to Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, and enables the next 3 attack(s) of "Souldragon" to deal Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type, equal to 112% of the Bondmate's Shield Effect. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae holds "Ode to Earth," the "Bondmate" deals 33.6% increased DMG. When used on Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, advances Souldragon's action by 100%. Souldragon's next action gains the enhancement effect of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate and the Shield Effect provided by Souldragon is 150% of its original Shield Effect. Does not consume the enhancement number of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate.

skills.label: Demiurge · Memosprite Skill: Ode to Ego (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: For every 1 different teammate (i.e., excluding Demiurge) from whom Cyrene has gained "Recollection," additionally deals 1 instance of Ice DMG equal to 84% of Demiurge's Max HP to one random enemy when Demiurge uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." After Cyrene uses Ultimate or when Demiurge is summoned, Demiurge immediately gains 1 "Story." When "Story" reaches 3, Demiurge consumes all "Story" points to immediately gain 1 extra turn and automatically use "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."

skills.label: Trace: Child of Remembrance
skills.gameText: When a teammate's memosprite is summoned, it gains "Future." "Future" held by the memosprite won't be consumed.

skills.label: Trace: Ripples Across Time
skills.gameText: When there are 1/2/3 Chrysos Heir or Remembrance characters (excluding Cyrene) in the team, Cyrene gains 2/3/6 "Recollection" point(s) respectively at the start of combat.

skills.label: Trace: Causality in Trichotomy
skills.gameText: When Cyrene's SPD is 180 or higher, increases all allies' DMG dealt by 20%. Then, for every 1 SPD that exceeds 180, increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's Ice RES PEN by 2%. Up to a maximum of 60 excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Epics, Born on a Blank Slate
skills.gameText: When Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains 6 "Recollection" point(s) and increases the number of bounces for this attack by 12.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: A Tomorrow in Thirteen Shades
skills.gameText: When entering combat, additionally gains 12 "Recollection" point(s). For every 1 different ally character that gains the Memosprite Skill buff from Demiurge, the DMG multiplier for the True DMG dealt by ally targets via the Skill's Zone increases by 6%, up to a max increase of 24%.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: By Thy Being, As I've Written
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Please Write On, With a Smile
skills.gameText: After every 1 use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes" by Demiurge, the Bounce DMG multiplier for the triggered Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" increases by 6% in the current battle, stacking up to 24 times.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Gaze, Steeped in Yesterbloom
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Remembrance, Sung in Ripples ♪
skills.gameText:
When Cyrene uses Ultimate for the first time, all allies advance action by 100%. Each time Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains the following effects based on the number of times it has been triggered in the current battle:
1 time: When Demiurge is on the field, reduces all enemy targets' DEF by 20%.
2 times and more: All allies advance action by 24%.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Cat Got Your Flametongue? (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Fire DMG equal to 100% of Sparxie's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.gameText: Start a livestream to turn Basic ATK into "Bloom! Winner Takes All" and trigger "Engagement Farming" 1 time. During this ability, "Engagement Farming" can be triggered repeatedly, up to 20 time(s). Using this ability is not considered as using a Skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Party's Wildin' and Camera's Rollin' (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Gains 2 Punchline point(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to (0.6 × Elation + 50.0%) of Sparxie's ATK to all enemies.

skills.label: Talent: Sleight of Sparx Hand (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
While Sparxie holds "Certified Banger":
Using Enhanced Basic ATK deals 40% Fire Elation DMG to one designated enemy, and 20.0% Fire Elation DMG to their adjacent targets. Additionally, for every 1 instance of "Engagement Farming" triggered, the Enhanced Basic ATK deals 1 extra instance of 20.0% Fire Elation DMG to 1 random attacked enemy target.
Using Ultimate deals 48% Fire Elation DMG to all enemies.

skills.label: Technique: Content Monetization
skills.gameText:
After using the Technique, inflicts enemies within a set area with "Block" for 10 second(s). "Blocked" enemies cannot detect ally targets.
After entering combat via actively attacking a "Blocked" enemy, deals Fire DMG to all enemies equal to 50% of Sparxie's ATK and recovers 2 Skill Point(s) for allies.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Bloom! Winner Takes All (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Finalizes the livestream. Deals Fire DMG equal to 100% of Sparxie's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG equal to 50.0% of Sparxie's ATK to adjacent targets.

skills.label: Skill: Engagement Farming (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Causes "Bloom! Winner Takes All" to increase the DMG multiplier against one designated enemy by 20.0% and the DMG multiplier against adjacent targets by 10.0%. Randomly gains one of the following gifts:
"Straight Fire": 2 Punchline point(s) and 2 Skill point(s).
"Unreal Banger": 1 Punchline point(s).
Using this ability is not considered as using a Skill.

skills.label: Elation Skill: Signal Overflow: The Great Encore! (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals 50.0% Fire Elation DMG to all enemies and deals 20 additional instance(s) of DMG. Each instance deals 25.0% Fire Elation DMG to one random enemy. Grants 2 "Thrill" point(s) to Sparxie, which can be used to offset Sparxie's Skill Point consumption. Consuming "Thrill" is considered as consuming Skill Points.

skills.label: Trace: Sweet! Punchline Signing
skills.gameText: For every 100 of Sparxie's ATK that exceeds 2000, increases this unit's Elation by 5.0%, up to a maximum increase of 80.0%.

skills.label: Trace: Dazzling! Persona Kaleidoscope
skills.gameText: When there are 1/2/≥3 Elation characters in the team, using Sparxie's Ultimate will additionally gain 2/4/8 Punchline and 1/1/4 "Thrill".

skills.label: Trace: Frenzy! Palette of Truth and Lies
skills.gameText: For every 1 Punchline currently owned, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 8%, up to a max increase of 80%.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: #GoingViral #WhoIsShe
skills.gameText: When Aha Instant ends, gains 5 Punchline. For every 1 Punchline owned, increases All-Type RES PEN for all allies by 1.5%, up to a max increase of 15%.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: #AudienceKnows
skills.gameText: When Aha Instant ends, Sparxie gains 1 extra turn and 2 "Thrill." For every 1 "Thrill" consumed, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by 10%, lasting for 2 turn(s) and stacking up to 4 time(s).

skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: #LockedIn #FaceCard
skills.gameText: When using Ultimate, additionally gains 5 Punchline and increases this unit's Elation by 36% for 3 turn(s).

skills.label: Eidolon 5: #HealingTheWorld #GoodVibesOnly
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.gameText: Increases All-Type RES PEN by 20%. For every 1 Punchline taken into account, the number of additional DMG instances dealt by the Elation Skill increases by 1, up to a max of 40.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Whistlebolt Sings Joy (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Physical DMG equal to 90% of Yao Guang's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to 30% of Yao Guang's ATK to targets adjacent to it. The Energy regenerated from Basic ATK increases to 30.

skills.label: Skill: Decalight Unveils All (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deploys a Zone for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While the Zone is active, increases all allies' Elation by an amount equal to 20.0% of Yao Guang's Elation. After Yao Guang uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains 3 Punchline.

skills.label: Ultimate: Hexagram of Feathered Fortune (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Gains 5 Punchline. Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of 20 Punchline is taken into account. This turn does not consume Punchline, and increases all allies' All-Type RES PEN by 20.0% for 3 turn(s).

skills.label: Talent: Behold Wherever Light Unfolds (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
While Yao Guang holds "Certified Banger":
After an ally target uses an attack, triggers the "Great Boon" effect, dealing 1 additional instance of 20.0% Elation DMG of the corresponding Type to 1 random hit target. If this attack consumes Skill Points, then additionally triggers "Great Boon" 1 time.
When triggering the "Great Boon" effect, if the attacker's Elation is lower than that of Yao Guang, then this instance of Elation DMG will take Yao Guang's Elation into calculation.
Triggering the "Great Boon" effect is not considered as using 1 instance of attack.

skills.label: Technique: Untethered Glimmer Sails Far
skills.gameText: After using Technique, automatically triggers Skill 1 time at the start of the next battle without consuming any Skill Points. When Yao Guang is in the team, breaking destructible objects immediately grants Fortune Pouch, up to 8 within every Earth Week.

skills.label: Elation Skill: Let Thy Fortune Burst in Flames (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Inflicts "Woe's Whisper" on all enemies, lasting for 3 turn(s). Enemy targets under the "Woe's Whisper" state take 16.0% increased DMG. Deals 100% Physical Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals 5 instance(s) of 20% Physical Elation DMG to one random enemy.

skills.label: Trace: Amaze-In Grace
skills.gameText: When Yao Guang's SPD is 120 or higher, increases this unit's Elation by 30%. For every 1 SPD exceeded, increases this unit's Elation by 1%. Up to a max of 200 excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

skills.label: Trace: Poised and Sated
skills.gameText: Increases this unit's CRIT DMG by 60%. After using Elation Skill, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for the team.

skills.label: Trace: Felicity Ensemble
skills.gameText: When Yao Guang gains "Certified Banger," its duration increases by 1 turn(s).

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Chuckle Chimes Where Jade Falls
skills.gameText: In Aha's extra turn triggered by Ultimate, the fixed amount of Punchline taken into account increases to 40. When dealing Elation DMG, all ally targets ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Blind Arrows Guided by Feathers
skills.gameText: While the Zone is active, increases all ally targets' SPD by 12%, and additionally increases Elation by 16%.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Auspices Mirrored In Decalight
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Threads of Fate Colored by Plumes
skills.gameText: In Aha's extra turn triggered by Yao Guang's Ultimate, the DMG dealt by all ally characters' Elation Skill becomes 150% of the original DMG.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Bejeweled in Radiant Grace
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Ferried Along the Astral Arc
skills.gameText: All ally targets' Elation DMG merrymakes by 25%. Increases the DMG multiplier of Yao Guang's Elation Skill by 100% of its original multiplier.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Brushstroke: Trace the Severed Stream (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Ice DMG equal to 90% of Pearl's DEF to one designated enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Relume Life's Light (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Gains 15 point(s) of "Certified Banger," restores HP for all ally targets equal to 12.0% of Pearl's DEF plus 240, and additionally restores HP for the ally target with the lowest current HP percentage by an amount equal to 12.0% of Pearl's DEF plus 240.

skills.label: Ultimate: Appraise Soul's Ground (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Gains 20 point(s) of "Certified Banger". Uses "Deep Learning" on one designated ally character other than this unit, making the target the "Aesthetic Archetype."
When there are 1/2/(3 or more) Elation characters on the team, advances the "Aesthetic Archetype's" action by 10%/15%/30% respectively. When there are 4 or more Elation characters on the team, the "Aesthetic Archetype" gains 1 extra turn. At the start of this extra turn, the "Aesthetic Archetype" gains 30 point(s) of "Certified Banger" and 60 point(s) of Punchline, which are removed at the end of the extra turn.
While "Deep Learning," Basic ATK "Brushstroke: Trace the Severed Stream" gets enhanced to "Brushstroke: Render the Great Wave." If the "Aesthetic Archetype" is on the Path of Elation, it is instead enhanced to "Brushstroke: Imagenate the Starry Night." And after attacking, additionally deals 60% Ice Elation DMG. This Elation DMG is calculated based on the "Aesthetic Archetype's" stats. "Deep Learning" has 3 point(s) of Charge. After Pearl uses an Enhanced Basic ATK, 1 point of Charge is consumed. If no Charge remains after taking action, "Deep Learning" ends.

skills.label: Talent: Grow Grace from Grit (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Pearl can use "Certified Banger" as Repellency. Each point of "Certified Banger" is equivalent to 200 point(s) of Repellency. When an ally target takes DMG, Pearl can consume Repellency to offset 60% of that DMG for the ally target. Pearl's "Certified Banger" lasts indefinitely and has a max limit of 50.
When an ally target's current HP percentage is 50% or lower, their DMG taken gets reduced by 30%.

skills.label: Technique: Recast Masterwork in Nacre
skills.gameText: After using Technique, gains "Aesthetic Archetype." When switching active characters, "Aesthetic Archetype" transfers to the currently active character. At the start of the next battle, Pearl gains 20 "Certified Banger" and applies "Deep Learning" on the character with "Aesthetic Archetype." This "Deep Learning" has 2 Charge. Pearl can only apply "Deep Learning" on characters other than herself.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Brushstroke: Imagenate the Starry Night (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Ice DMG equal to 100% of Pearl's DEF to all enemies, restores HP for all ally targets equal to 8.0% of Pearl's DEF plus 160, and additionally restores HP for the ally target with the lowest current HP percentage by an amount equal to 8.0% of Pearl's DEF plus 160. While holding "Certified Banger", additionally deals 15% Ice Elation DMG.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Brushstroke: Render the Great Wave (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Ice DMG equal to 100% of Pearl's DEF to all enemies. Restores HP for all ally targets equal to 8.0% of Pearl's DEF plus 160, and additionally restores HP for the ally with the lowest current HP percentage by an amount equal to 8.0% of Pearl's DEF plus 160.

skills.label: Elation Skill: Dissolve Reason into Elation (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When there are 1/2/3/(4 or more) Elation characters in the team, then after all ally targets use their next attack, enables them to additionally deal Elation DMG of their corresponding Type to the attack target, equal to 10.0%/15.0%/20.0%/40.0% respectively.

skills.label: Trace: Panoptic Vision
skills.gameText: When Pearl's DEF is 2400 or higher, increases this unit's Elation by 32%. For every 100 DEF exceeding that threshold, increases this unit's Elation by 3%. Up to a max of 3600 excess DEF can be taken into account for this effect. Pearl gains Outgoing Healing Boost, equal to 20% of this unit's Elation.

skills.label: Trace: Sensory Latitude
skills.gameText: While holding "Certified Banger," increases all ally targets' Effect RES by 50%. When an ally target's turn begins, Pearl gains 5 point(s) of "Certified Banger," up to a max of 50 point(s) of "Certified Banger." skills.gameText: When the CRIT DMG boost effect from the Talent "Gem Magecraft" applies to Rin Tohsaka, the effect can stack, up to 2 time(s).
