skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Nailed It This Time!
skills.gameText: Rin Tohsaka's All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%. When using Ultimate, gains 24 "Gem Energy" and 1 extra turn.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Halfhearted Blow (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 100% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Gate of Babylon (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Gains "King's Acknowledgement," allowing this unit to ignore 30% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG, lasting for 3 turn(s).
Deals Lightning DMG equal to 280% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Lightning DMG equal to 140% of Gilgamesh's ATK to adjacent targets.

skills.label: Ultimate: Enuma Elish (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 400% of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals 10 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Lightning DMG equal to 100% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one random enemy.

skills.label: Talent: "Amuse Me to the Fullest" (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
When a teammate uses their Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," which increases Ultimate DMG dealt by this unit by 40%, lasting for 3 turn(s).
Initially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Interest." For each point of "Interest" in possession, increases this unit's SPD by 10%.
When "Interest" reaches 10 for the first time, enters the "Interest Piqued!" state. In that state, can only use Skill, lasting for the entire battle. After using Skill, clears this unit's "Interest."

skills.label: Talent: "I Grant You Permission To Strike" (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
When Gilgamesh or Saber attacks, the attack tally increases by 1. After any unit attacks, if the attack tally reaches 8, Gilgamesh and Saber launch Joint Follow-Up ATK, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 400% of Gilgamesh's ATK and Wind DMG equal to 600% of Saber's ATK to all enemies, respectively. Then, Gilgamesh gains 3 "Interest." Saber regenerates a fixed 120 Energy, and the next time she uses Ultimate, the DMG dealt becomes 200% of the original DMG.
After using Joint Follow-Up ATK, resets the attack tally.

skills.label: Technique: Enkidu
skills.gameText:
After using Technique, creates 1 Special Dimension lasting for 10 second(s). Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state. Enemies in the "King's Permission" state will cease all actions.
When entering combat by actively attacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state, causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat, and deals Lightning DMG equal to 200% of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies after entering combat. Gilgamesh also immediately gains 3 "Interest." Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skills.label: Trace: Epic's Opening
skills.gameText: When Gilgamesh uses Ultimate, gains 2 "Interest." When other ally characters use Ultimate, Gilgamesh additionally gains 2 "Interest" and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to 30% of the Energy consumed this time.

skills.label: Trace: Hero's Hauteur
skills.gameText: During the current battle, for every 1 point of "Interest" gained by Gilgamesh, increases his CRIT DMG by 25%. This effect can stack up to 6 time(s).

skills.label: Trace: Hegemon's Strife
skills.gameText: While Gilgamesh is on the field, increases all ally targets' ATK by 20% and CRIT DMG by 20%. If the target's Max Energy exceeds 140, for every 1 excess point of Max Energy, additionally increases ATK and CRIT DMG by 1%, up to a maximum additional increase of 100%.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: He Who Saw the Deep
skills.gameText: When Gilgamesh holds "King's Acknowledgement," its DEF-ignoring effect also applies to other teammates, and "King's Acknowledgement" additionally increases Gilgamesh's ATK by 60%. When using Skill, additionally regenerates a fixed 40 Energy.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Wisdom That Encompassed All
skills.gameText: When entering combat, Gilgamesh gains 5 "Interest." When using Ultimate, additionally gains 5 "Interest." The DMG multiplier of the Skill "Gate of Babylon" against the primary target increases by 100%, and its DMG multiplier against adjacent targets increases by 50%.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Journey That Spanned Far
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: King Who Bowed to None
skills.gameText: Gilgamesh's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 20%.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Sword That Parted Gods from Man
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Soul That Bore Friendship
skills.gameText: Increases the bounce DMG multiplier of the Ultimate "Enuma Elish" by 80%. While Gilgamesh is on the field, increases ally characters' All-Type RES PEN by 20%. When a teammate uses Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Golden Rule," up to a total of 3 points. When this unit uses Ultimate, consumes all "Golden Rule" points, and each point of "Golden Rule" consumed increases the CRIT DMG for the Ultimate DMG dealt by 100%.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Enkindle the First Lodestar (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Fire DMG equal to 100% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Upraise the Vanward Cresset (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: After using Skill, immediately recovers all Assist Skill uses. Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore," lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Himeko • Nova's every turn. When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt by all allies increases by 20%. At the start of every turn, immediately recovers 1 Assist Skill use.

skills.label: Ultimate: We, Too, Stride the Stars (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Immediately takes control of "Starblazer." "Starblazer" can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" against enemies 6 times, or consume "Source Energy" to launch "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," dealing Fire DMG up to 762% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG up to 252% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to other targets.
When the uses of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" are depleted, automatically launches "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," followed by Final Hit, dealing 3 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to 80% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
When "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field, or when enemy HP can no longer be reduced, immediately launches Final Hit.

skills.label: Talent: Of Fire and Far Faring (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the Territory "Starblazer Visioscape," summoning "Starblazer" to the field and granting all ally characters 1 Assist Skill use. Ally characters can use Assist Skill to call upon "Starblazer" to attack enemies.
Using Assist Skill is considered as Himeko • Nova using her Skill. Himeko • Nova gains 20% increased All-Type RES PEN and 80% increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, can ignore Weakness Types to reduce enemy Toughness. When breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use their Assist Skill, regenerates 4 Energy for them.

skills.label: Technique: Starcharter Cruise
skills.gameText:
When Himeko • Nova is in the team, increases the max Technique Points by 3.
After using Technique, enters the "Cruise" state for 30 seconds. Actively using the Technique consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, immediately uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.
If attacking a Normal Enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

skills.label: Ultimate: Hyperluminal Particle Beam (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Fire DMG equal to 32% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies and gains 1 point(s) of "Source Energy." A maximum of 3 "Source Energy" can be held.

skills.label: Ultimate: Orbital Annihilation Pulse (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Consumes 1 point of "Source Energy" to deal Fire DMG equal to 20% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies. When the current "Source Energy" is more than 1, for every 1 point(s) of "Source Energy" consumed, additionally deals 1 instance of Fire DMG equal to 30% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.

skills.label: Assist Skill: Trailblaze, By Your Side (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Deals Fire DMG equal to 160% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals 3 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to 24% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy. When used by Himeko • Nova, deals Fire DMG equal to 200% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals 4 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to 32% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
If the user is a Trailblaze Companions character other than Himeko • Nova, then depending on the user, Himeko • Nova additionally gains 1 of the Special Effects.
The extra Assist Skill via all Special Effects can be launched up to 2 time(s) per battle, and this count is reset after Himeko • Nova uses her Ultimate.

skills.label: Assist Skill: Companion Protocol: Verdict (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state. Increases DMG dealt by Himeko • Nova by 100%, and additionally increases her Ultimate DMG dealt by 100%. After Himeko • Nova's teammates actively use their Ultimate 2 time(s), Himeko • Nova immediately launches 1 Assist Skill against enemies at no cost.

skills.label: Assist Skill: Companion Protocol: Decimation (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state. Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 100%, and additionally increases the CRIT DMG dealt by Skill by 100%. For every 1 enemy target hit by allies, gains 1 Charge. When Charge reaches 9, consumes all Charge, and Himeko • Nova immediately launches 1 Assist Skill against enemies at no cost. This instance of Assist Skill cannot grant Charge.

skills.label: Trace: Whither, the Last and First Men?
skills.gameText: When Himeko • Nova launches Assist Skill, it does not consume Assist Skill uses. At the start of the turn, if the Assist Skill uses have reached the current cap, Himeko • Nova additionally regenerates 5 Energy.

skills.label: Trace: Hark! The Express's Pulse Roars
skills.gameText: When a Trailblaze Companions character other than Himeko • Nova uses Assist Skill, that character immediately gains 1 extra turn in which they can insert the use of their Ultimate. The extra turn gained from Assist Skill will not repeatedly trigger this Trace effect.

skills.label: Trace: The Silver Rail, Hushed in Antiquity
skills.gameText: When using Ultimate, immediately gains 3 "Source Energy." If the current "Source Energy" is 3 or more, when using the "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" attack, the DMG multiplier of "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" against random single enemies increases by 30%.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: That Which We Stride Is the Trailblaze
skills.gameText: The number of extra Assist Skill uses from Talent additionally increases by 1. While in the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state, reduces the number of Ultimate uses required to launch Assist Skill by 1. While in the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state, reduces the Charge required to launch Assist Skill by 3. When Himeko • Nova launches Assist Skill, the number of extra DMG instances increases by 1.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: The Colors We Never Strike
skills.gameText: The cap of Himeko • Nova's Assist Skill uses increases to 2, and the DMG dealt by Ultimate and Assist Skill becomes 130% of their original DMG. During the "Navigator's Semaphore" state, at the start of each turn, additionally recovers 1 use of Assist Skill immediately. When a non-Trailblaze Companions character uses Assist Skill, the Trace "Hark! The Express's Pulse Roars" now also grants them 1 extra turn.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: We Who Are Starborn Muse Starward
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Let No Skyward Hand Stay Unheld
skills.gameText: When using Assist Skill via the Talent "Of Fire and Far Faring," the All-Type RES PEN boost now applies to all allies. And when Himeko • Nova gains this effect, her All-Type RES PEN additionally increases by 10%.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: To Cross the Cosmos and Beyond
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: Ours Is the Oath to Sail Starward
skills.gameText: Himeko • Nova's Fire RES PEN increases by 20%. The cap of "Source Energy" increases to 6. When an ally uses or launches Assist Skill, DMG dealt by Assist Skill increases by 75%, and Himeko • Nova gains 1 "Source Energy." When launching "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" during Ultimate, additionally gains 1 "Source Energy". When launching "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," if the current "Source Energy" is 6 or more, additionally deals 1 instance of Fire DMG to all enemies, equal to 160% of Himeko • Nova's ATK.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Starfrost, Showtime! (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals 50% Quantum Elation DMG to one designated enemy target.

skills.label: Skill: This Emanator Was Certified by Aha™ (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Causes one designated ally character (except this unit) to gain the "Emanator of Elation" state, then immediately launches a Follow-up ATK, dealing 50% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies. The "Emanator of Elation" state lasts for the entire battle until switching to the next target. The target with the "Emanator of Elation" state has their Elation stat increased by 20% and, at the start of their turn, causes Aeon ★ Aha to gain 1 point(s) of "Wishpower."

skills.label: Ultimate: Aha! Let There Be Laughter (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Causes Aha's action to advance by 20%. Aeon ★ Aha gains the "Faces of Elation" state, lasting for 3 turn(s). At the start of each Aeon ★ Aha's turn, duration decreases by 1. Deals 200% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, then deals 5 instance(s) of DMG. Each instance deals 60% Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy.

skills.label: Talent: Work Wonders with THEM (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: The Ultimate can be activated once "Wishpower" reaches 8 point(s). Wishpower can overflow until 10 after reaching its max. Aeon ★ Aha gains 1 point(s) of "Wishpower" after using Basic ATK, Skill, or Elation Skill. Once allies' Punchline reaches 40 point(s) for the first time, Aeon ★ Aha will immediately gain 1 points of "Wishpower" and increase all allies' CRIT DMG by 40%, lasting for 3 turn(s). This can be triggered again after Aha's turn ends.

skills.label: Technique: ABRACADABRA!
skills.gameText: After using the Technique, creates a Special Dimension around this unit lasting 20 second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are inflicted with "Misjudgment." Enemies inflicted with "Misjudgment" cannot detect ally targets. After entering combat, Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn that adds a fixed 20 Punchline to the count. Only 1 dimension effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skills.label: Elation Skill: Yes Aha At Full Moon (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Ignores Participant ID and is always used at the end of the Aha Instant. Deals Quantum Elation DMG equal to 60% to all enemies, then deals True DMG equal to 20% of total non-True DMG dealt by ally targets this Aha Instant, equally distributed among all enemies.

skills.label: Innate Trace: Faces of Elation ★ Ex Nihilo (Lv. 2)
skills.gameText: While possessing the "Faces of Elation" state, Aeon ★ Aha causes allies' Path of Elation to ascend, enhancing Punchline and the "Certified Banger" state into Bliss and the "Party Trick" state. Bliss recovers 10% of the consumed Punchline at the end of the "Aha Instant" turn. During "Faces of Elation," Aeon ★ Aha's CRIT Rate increases by 20%, and the DMG dealt by Aeon ★ Aha ignores 60% of the enemy target's DEF.

skills.label: Talent: The True Story of Aha
skills.gameText: When Aeon ★ Aha and teammates deal DMG, additionally deal "Elation Debt" effect equal to 25% of DMG to the enemy target. During the enemy target's phase transition, they maintain the "Elation Debt" value, with a maximum not exceeding 10% of the target's Max HP.

skills.label: Trace: A Prank on Aeons
skills.gameText: Skill's Follow-Up ATK additionally deals 20% Elation DMG of the corresponding Type to the target with "Emanator of Elation" state and recovers 1 Skill Point(s). The Elation DMG additionally dealt in this instance does not count as 1 instance of attack.

skills.label: Trace: A Carnival in Whimsy
skills.gameText: When receiving healing or a Shield provided by a teammate, gains 1 point(s) of "Wishpower." This can be triggered up to 1 times. The trigger count resets after using Ultimate.

skills.label: Trace: A Box of Everything
skills.gameText: When Aeon ★ Aha's SPD reaches 125/150 or higher, Elation increases by 120%/150%. When entering combat, advances THEIR own action by 30%.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Who Giggled at the Primordial Hush?
skills.gameText: When entering combat, immediately gains 5 point(s) of "Wishpower." When Aeon ★ Aha is present, merrymakes Elation DMG dealt by all ally targets by 15%.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: Between THEIR Eyes and Yours
skills.gameText:
Enhances Path of Elation Ascension effects:
#{series_ref_skill_desc:UIText_SeriesSkillDescFormat,151129,2}

skills.label: Eidolon 3: A Stacked Deck of Sorrow and Joy
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: A Joke's Fate Boxed in Black
skills.gameText: The multiplier of the True DMG dealt by Elation Skills increases by 25% of the original multiplier. When Aeon ★ Aha deals Elation DMG, an additional 100% of the cumulative "Certified Banger" stacks possessed by teammates will be taken into account.

skills.label: Eidolon 5: Moi Onstage and Me Offstage
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: For THEY Said: You Are Elation
skills.gameText: Enemy targets always have the "Elation Debt" effect that is at least equal to 20% of the target's Max HP. The first time Aeon ★ Aha uses THEIR Ultimate, Aha's action advances by 100%, and Aha gains 100 Punchline(s).

skills.label: Basic ATK: The Sea Sings in My Key (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Wind DMG equal to 50% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP to one enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Summer Strums the Soul (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Summons the memosprite "Summer Songbirds" Bessie. If any member of the "Summer Songbirds" is already on the field, restores their HP by an amount equal to 100% of "Summer Songbirds'" Max HP, and gains 6 Vibes.

skills.label: Ultimate: Ascend That Rhapsody in Blue (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Advances the action of one designated ally character (excluding Robin • Summeretto) by 100% and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to 20.0% of their Max Energy. Then, grants them the "Special Guest" effect. When the "Special Guest" character or their summon attacks, they additionally grant Robin • Summeretto 2 Vibes but cannot make other friendly targets gain the action advance effect. This lasts for 2 turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this character's turn.

skills.label: Talent: Wings Heed No Borders (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Memosprite "Summer Songbirds" has an initial Max HP equal to 70% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP and an initial SPD equal to 180% of Robin • Summeretto's SPD. When an ally target uses an attack, or when they provide healing or Shield for the first time in any target's turn, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes by 1 point, capped at 50. While "Summer Songbirds" Bessie is on the field, if Robin • Summeretto's Vibes is 6 or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie, and if Vibes is 12 or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Paddie. When all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted upon Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds", starts the "Fever" state, and deploys a Zone. When ally targets deal DMG within the Zone, they ignore a percentage of enemy targets' DEF equal to (15.0% + Vibes × 0.5%).
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.

skills.label: Technique: We Are the Melody
skills.gameText: After using Technique, advances action by 20% at the start of the next battle, immediately gains 6 Vibes, and increases all allies' DMG dealt by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

skills.label: Summer Songbirds · Memosprite Skill: Chirrup Quartet (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Wind DMG equal to 210.0% of "Summer Songbirds'" Max HP to all enemies.

skills.label: Summer Songbirds · Memosprite Talent: A Warble of Wings (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: While in the "Fever" state, the "Summer Songbirds" and a countdown will appear on the Action Order. And the DMG dealt by Robin • Summeretto and "Summer Songbirds" increases by an amount equal to (84% + Vibes × 2.8%). When "Summer Songbirds'" turn starts, uses the Memosprite Skill. The countdown has an initial SPD of 140. And when its turn starts, deducts 50% of the current Vibes (minimum 12 points). When the Vibes reaches 0, the "Summer Songbirds" disappears and Robin • Summeretto exits the "Fever" state. While the "Summer Songbirds" is on the field, based on the number of its members present, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by 11.2%/16.8%/22.4% respectively.

skills.label: Summer Songbirds · Memosprite Talent: Near the Sea's Heartbeat (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When the "Summer Songbirds" gets summoned, regenerates 20 Energy for Robin • Summeretto.

skills.label: Summer Songbirds · Memosprite Talent: Astride Summer's Nightwind (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When the "Summer Songbirds" disappears, Robin • Summeretto's action advances by 50%.

skills.label: Trace: Deviated Chords
skills.gameText: When an ally target causes Robin • Summeretto to gain Vibes, if their ATK is higher than Robin • Summeretto's, increases that target's ATK by an amount equal to (16% + Vibes × 0.4%) of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP. Otherwise, increases that target's CRIT DMG by an amount equal to (40% + Vibes × 1.5%). Lasts for 2 turn(s).

skills.label: Trace: Improvised Blues
skills.gameText: When Robin • Summeretto or the "Summer Songbirds" receive healing or Shield provided by teammates, causes Robin • Summeretto to gain 12 stack(s) of "Groove," capped at 12. The first time Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes during any target's turn, if she has "Groove," consumes 1 stack of "Groove" and regenerates a fixed 3 Energy.

skills.label: Trace: Rebuilt Harmony
skills.gameText: Increases the CRIT Rate of Robin • Summeretto and "Summer Songbirds" by 50%.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Stray Bird of Summer
skills.gameText: "Summer Songbirds" will keep a tally of 100% of the non-True DMG dealt by ally targets. When using the Memosprite Skill, additionally deals True DMG to the enemy target with the highest HP, equal to (11% + current Vibes × 0.1%) of the total tally. Then, clears 50% of the tally.

skills.label: Eidolon 2: A Heart of Still Water
skills.gameText: Ally targets' All-Type RES PEN increases by 18%. The upper limit of Robin • Summeretto's Vibes increases by 20. The first time an ally target uses an ability during any target's turn to cause Robin • Summeretto to gain Vibes, she gains an additional 2 points.

skills.label: Eidolon 3: Echoes Left Along the Way
skills.gameText:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 4: Her Variation on the Theme
skills.gameText: Upon entering the "Fever" state, immediately gains 12 Vibes, and increases the SPD of "Summer Songbirds" by an amount equal to (20% + current Vibes × 0.5%).

skills.label: Eidolon 5: To Chase the Dawn Anew
skills.gameText:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

skills.label: Eidolon 6: A Song Yet Unnamed
skills.gameText: Increases the Memosprite Skill's DMG multiplier by 100% of its original value. While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto can store her Ultimate up to 2 times. After entering the "Fever" state for the first time in this battle or when the the "Fever" countdown's turn starts, regenerates a fixed 140 Energy.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Dead Center, the Torrent Hits (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 100% of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.label: Skill: Kill Shot, the Sands Boil (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 240% of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to all enemies. Gains 4 Punchline and 4 "Fervor."

skills.label: Ultimate: Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 400% of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to all enemies. Gains 6 Punchline and 8 "Fervor." Increases this unit's SPD by 30%, lasting for 4 turn(s).

skills.label: Talent: Ante Up, the Abyss Answers (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
The duration of Aventurine • Waveflair's "Certified Banger" increases by 1 turn. After a teammate uses an attack, Aventurine • Waveflair gains 1 "Fervor" and 1 Punchline. "Fervor" is capped at 30 points.
When "Fervor" reaches 10, Aventurine • Waveflair uses 1 instance of "Cheers! To Summer's Blaze" that takes into account a fixed amount of 20 Punchline. After this use, the next Elation Skill used by this unit in the Aha Instant gets enhanced into "All In! To Summer's Blaze."
While Aventurine • Waveflair holds "Certified Banger," Skill additionally deals 40% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and Ultimate additionally deals 72% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies.

skills.label: Technique: Make Waves in Still Waters
skills.gameText: Moves forward rapidly for a set distance, attacking all enemies in contact and blocking all incoming attacks. skills.gameText: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of 130 and a Max HP equal to 80% of Trailblazer's Max HP plus 640. For every 10 Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.

skills.label: Technique: Memories Back as Echoes
skills.gameText:
After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 10 second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are placed in a Time Stop state, halting all their actions.
After entering battle against enemies afflicted with the Time Stop state, delays the action of all enemies by 50%, and then deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to 100% of Trailblazer's ATK.
Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skills.label: Basic ATK: Together, We Script Tomorrow! (Lv. 6)
skills.gameText: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all Crowd Control debuffs on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a Joint ATK, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to 120% of Trailblazer's ATK and 120% of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains 10% Charge.

skills.label: Mem · Memosprite Skill: Baddies! Trouble! (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Ice DMG equal to 50.4% of Mem's ATK to one random enemy. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to 126% of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

skills.label: Mem · Memosprite Talent: Friends! Together! (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by an amount equal to 16.8% of Mem's CRIT DMG plus 33.6%.
If the Charge has yet to reach 100%, Mem automatically uses "Baddies! Trouble!" when taking action. When the Charge reaches 100%, Mem immediately takes action. In the next action, can select one ally and use "Lemme! Help You!".

skills.label: Mem · Memosprite Talent: Go, Mem, Go! (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains 50% Charge.

skills.label: Mem · Memosprite Talent: No... Regrets (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: When Mem disappears, Trailblazer's action advances by 25%.

skills.label: Mem · Memosprite Skill: Lemme! Help You! (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Advances the action of one designated ally by 100% and grants them "Mem's Support," lasting for 3 turn(s).
For every 1 instance of DMG dealt by a target that has "Mem's Support," additionally deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to 36% of the original DMG.
When using this ability on this unit, cannot trigger the action advance effect.

skills.gameText: When the battle starts, Trailblazer's action advances by 30%. When Mem is first summoned, grants Mem 40% Charge.

skills.label: Trace: Magnets and Long Chains
skills.gameText: When the Max Energy of an ally target that has "Mem's Support" exceeds 100, for every 10 excess Energy, additionally increases the multiplier of the True DMG dealt via "Mem's Support" by 2%, up to a max increase of 20%.

skills.label: Ultimate: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:
Gains 5 Punchline point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by 50% for 3 turn(s), and dispels Crowd Control debuffs on them.
If the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain 10 point(s) of "Certified Banger" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of 20 Punchline point(s). If the target does not have Elation Skill, their action advances by 50%.

skills.label: Talent: That Smile Hits Different (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText:

When the Trailblazer holds "Certified Banger," their Skill additionally deals 30% Lightning Elation DMG to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "Certified Banger" value among all allies.

skills.label: Technique: We Are So Back!
skills.gameText:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by 30%.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by 20%.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for 3 turn(s).

skills.label: Elation Skill: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter? (Lv. 10)
skills.gameText: Deals 8 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing 20% Lightning Elation DMG to one random enemy. At last, deals 60% Lightning Elation DMG, which is split evenly among all enemies.

skills.label: Trace: On Cloud Nine
skills.gameText: For every 200 point(s) of Trailblazer's ATK that exceeds 1000, increases this unit's Elation stat by 10.0%, up to a maximum increase of 60.0%.

skills.gameText: Increases this unit's CRIT Rate by 15%. After using Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for the team.

skills.label: Trace: Aha, Sic 'Em!
skills.gameText: After an ally target uses Elation Skill, Trailblazer additionally gains 2 point(s) of "Certified Banger" the next time they use their Skill.

skills.label: Eidolon 1: Believe In the Light
skills.gameText: After using Skill, the next Ultimate increases the amount of "Certified Banger" gained by ally targets by 2. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s).
